faqs.q: What is Telangana's long-term GSDP target for 2047?
faqs.e: Part of the "Telangana Rising 2047" vision.

faqs.q: What is Telangana's interim GSDP milestone target for 2034?
faqs.e: Interim milestone on the way to the USD 3 trillion 2047 target.

faqs.q: What spatial planning model is Telangana using to achieve balanced growth?
faqs.e: Divides the State into three sector-specific economic zones for balanced, inclusive, sustainable growth.

faqs.q: What does CURE-PURE-RARE stand for?
faqs.a: Core Urban Region – Peri-Urban Region – Rural Agriculture Region
faqs.e: CURE strengthens Hyderabad as a tech/DeepTech/AI hub; PURE develops manufacturing corridors and MSME clusters; RARE enhances rural incomes via agriculture, livestock, and eco-tourism.

faqs.q: What real GDP growth rates does Telangana forecast for 2025-30, 2031-39, and 2041-47 respectively?
faqs.e: Forecast to sustain high double-digit-adjacent growth over two decades to reach the 2047 goal.

faqs.a: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
faqs.e: Through its National Accounts Division.

faqs.e: Helps better capture the unorganised sector for more realistic measurement.

faqs.q: Under the CURE-PURE-RARE framework, what will CURE (Core Urban Region) focus on?
faqs.a: Hyderabad as a global hub for technology, DeepTech, AI, and Industry 4.0
faqs.e: Reinforces the state's leadership in knowledge-based sectors.

faqs.q: Under the CURE-PURE-RARE framework, what will PURE (Peri-Urban Region) focus on?
faqs.a: Manufacturing corridors, MSME clusters, and integrated logistics networks
faqs.e: Deepens industrial capacity and strengthens links between urban centres and surrounding regions.

faqs.q: Under the CURE-PURE-RARE framework, what will RARE (Rural Agriculture Region) focus on?
faqs.a: Rural incomes via agriculture, livestock, fisheries, handlooms, handicrafts, and eco-tourism
faqs.e: Also includes forest-based activities to diversify rural livelihoods.
